entry.title: Binance Hack Wallet Moves Another $248 Million in ETH
entry.summary: Twelve transfers made up the largest of three daily batches, but the transactions were wallet-to-wallet movements, not bitcoin swaps.

entry.title: HSBC Opens Tokenized Fund Subscriptions With RedCoin
entry.summary: Hong Kong retail customers can invest from HK$100 through the bank’s mobile app in a new share class of an existing money market fund.

entry.title: COTI Sets Year-End Shutdown for DJED and SHEN Services
entry.summary: COTI urged holders to act by the Dec. 31 cutoff and withdraw any tokens deposited in DeFi first. About 1 million DJED remain in circulation.

entry.title: MAS Issues S$100 Million in Tokenized Bills With CBDC
entry.summary: The live auction drew applications for more than twice the issuance size. MAS plans to scale up issuance and broaden use of the bills as collateral.

entry.title: TradeXYZ to Halt Oura Pre-IPO Perpetual on Dec. 1
entry.summary: Positions left open will settle at a time-weighted average price from market launch through the halt, rather than at the final traded price.

entry.title: BNB Chain Sets Jenner Date; Post Flags Timestamp Risk
entry.summary: A forum analysis warns that BEP-706's sample code could let expired quotes pass a timing check if its timestamp call succeeds but returns no data.

entry.title: Intel Says It Signed First Outside 18A-P Chip Customer
entry.summary: Intel's technology chief identified the unnamed customer's process as 18A-P. The company had already announced 18A projects with Microsoft and AWS.

entry.title: Lightning Labs' pi402 Lets Coding Agents Pay in Bitcoin
entry.summary: Announced Nov. 12, the Pi extension can buy prepaid token bundles over Lightning from metered sellers. Osuntokun's separate mainnet endpoint advertises DeepSeek inference.

entry.title: LUKSO Blames Email Recovery Flaw for Profile Thefts
entry.summary: The project says about 300 accounts lost roughly 1.4 million LYX. It is retiring email recovery, but affected holders still need to remove the attacker's key.

entry.title: BlackRock’s IBIT Resumes Outflows After One-Day Break
entry.summary: IBIT lost $209.5 million on Nov. 17, a day after an inflow offset just 3.3% of its preceding $2.35 billion withdrawal streak.

entry.title: Binance Opens US Stock Options to API Trading With USDC
entry.summary: Eligible traders can automate orders and exercise instructions. USDC funds the trades, but standard contracts settle by delivery of shares held through Alpaca.

entry.title: Texas Resumes Environmental Permit Reviews for Data Centers
entry.summary: TCEQ says normal reviews have resumed after a September directive to pause permit issuance. ERCOT targets Dec. 10 for its final community-impact report.

entry.title: OpenAI Reports Agent Gains on Multihour Research Tasks
entry.summary: Documented workweeks in safety and alignment rose 77% from January to September, OpenAI says. It also renewed a call for mandatory AI-research disclosures.

entry.title: Microsoft Plans Intel EMIB Packaging for Azure Chips
entry.summary: The agreement also confirms multi-year Xeon capacity, including Diamond Rapids, without naming the Azure chips slated for Intel packaging.

entry.title: Tencent's AI Buildout Deepens Free Cash Flow Deficit
entry.summary: Capital expenditure payments rose 225% as cloud revenue growth accelerated to 35% and WorkBuddy topped 10 million daily users.

entry.title: Kraken Parent Payward Agrees to Acquire Tribe Capital
entry.summary: The venture firm, chaired by Payward and Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi, manages $2.7 billion, Payward says. Closing is expected in early 2027.

entry.title: GAO Says Four AI Chatbots Helped Develop Attack Plans
entry.summary: GAO says investigators obtained usable information in under 12 hours per platform in spring tests, but the findings cannot rank the chatbots’ safety.

entry.title: Sunrise Plans Anthropic Stock Token for Solana Debut
entry.summary: Sunrise names Backpack Securities for its planned IPO-day token. Published legal terms distinguish wallet-held receipts from shares held in a brokerage account.

entry.title: Babylon Co-Founder Proposes Ending Bitcoin Staking
entry.summary: Fisher Yu's year-end sunset proposal would stop rewards and new stakes while preserving withdrawal rules, as Babylon focuses on Bitcoin collateral.

entry.title: Coinbase Offers Anthropic Perp Ahead of Nasdaq Debut
entry.summary: Eligible non-US traders can take USDC-settled positions with up to 5x leverage, without receiving shares or an IPO allocation.

entry.title: Injective's Veyra Upgrade Passes Vote, Targets Nov. 24
entry.summary: Validators must switch to v1.21.0 at block 193,145,000. The approved package adds cross-chain and trading tools, while CypherOS privacy remains on the roadmap.

entry.title: NEAR Ratifies Issuance Cut, Pending Validator Upgrade
entry.summary: HSP-029 targets a 1.6% issuance cap over 24 months. A quarter-long grace period and separate validator adoption stand between ratification and lower emissions.

entry.title: Report: ByteDance AI Sales Strain Microsoft–OpenAI Ties
entry.summary: Microsoft executives told OpenAI they found no evidence of distillation, The Information says, as ByteDance discusses roughly $500 million more in cloud spending.

entry.title: Stacks Sets 4.1 Vote on Clarity 7, BTC Deposit Changes
entry.summary: The proposal needs 80% approval in both the staked- and liquid-STX tallies, with at least 80 million staked STX participating.

entry.title: MEXC Shuts Visa-Linked Global Card After Payment Pause
entry.summary: Unused balances will move automatically to spot accounts after a Nov. 21 snapshot. Merchant refunds and eligible fee rebates follow separate return arrangements.

entry.title: Blockaid Flags 8,800-Plus GTA-Themed Solana Tokens
entry.summary: Fake pre-orders and airdrops lead to wallet drainers, Blockaid says. Its four-month Solana token count combines malicious verdicts, warnings and spam.

entry.title: Waller Backs Half-Point December Hike Unless Fed Signals a January Increase
entry.summary: Morning futures pricing on Nov. 18 put a quarter-point hike at 95%, as the Fed governor argued for a larger move unless policymakers clearly signal another increase in January.

entry.title: Strategy's STRC Hits Lowest Since August at $95.50
entry.summary: The preferred closed 3.9% below its $100 stated amount, limiting new issuance even after $228.1 million of buybacks in the latest reported week.

entry.title: Pre-Release GPT-6.2 Astra Cyber Jailbreak Took Half the Queries
entry.summary: In single-turn cyber tests, a researcher developed a jailbreak in half the queries needed for GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI changed safeguards, but UK testers had not independently tested the latest changes as of their Nov. 17 account.

entry.title: Gonka Bridge Exploit Drains Stablecoins, Mints WGNK
entry.summary: Ethereum records show withdrawals of 884,151 USDT and 648 USDC, plus the creation of 22 million WGNK that Blockaid described as unbacked.

entry.title: Solana Says Akash Is Building a GPU Forward Market
entry.summary: The planned market would extend Akash’s compute business as it prepares to move from Cosmos. A separate draft describes fixed-price reservations for future capacity.

entry.title: Net Share of Managers Overweight Tech Falls in BofA Poll
entry.summary: The net share of managers overweight tech fell to 12% from 37% in October, Bloomberg reported, while the survey balance remained positive.

entry.title: Bessent Points to Commerce in Megaspeed Blacklist Split
entry.summary: The Treasury secretary said four agencies backed listing Megaspeed for months. Commerce and Justice say a criminal investigation is continuing.

entry.title: Ethereum Faces Glamsterdam Gas-Rule Decision Thursday
entry.summary: Developers will discuss whether to change rules that can alter how existing contracts handle failed operations. Glamsterdam’s activation on Hoodi remains on hold.

entry.title: Anchorage Adds Custodied Crypto Margin for Kalshi Prime
entry.summary: Institutions can pledge bitcoin and stablecoins without moving the crypto to the trading venue, Anchorage says. Custody does not remove liquidation risk.

entry.title: Science Raises $400 Million for Sight-Restoring Implant
entry.summary: The financing backs PRIMA’s European rollout and a planned US launch that still requires FDA approval.

entry.title: Bitwise Moves Beyond Crypto With AI Cyber Defense ETF
entry.summary: ZDAY trades on NYSE Arca with a 0.75% annual expense ratio and 16 holdings, led by Palo Alto Networks and CrowdStrike.

entry.title: Coinbase Opens Morpho-Backed Crypto Loans in New York
entry.summary: New Yorkers can borrow USDC against bitcoin, ether and SOL, but fixed-rate loans and the broader collateral menu remain unavailable in the state.

entry.title: California Halts Waymo Freeway Rides, KRON4 Reports
entry.summary: The restrictions took effect Nov. 11 and require corrective action before freeway service can resume, KRON4 reported. Waymo says surface-street rides continue.

entry.title: Google Launches Gemini Robotics Plugin for Antigravity
entry.summary: The workbench pairs MuJoCo simulation with camera-guided control. Antigravity access requires a paid Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription.

entry.title: PJM Proposes One-Year Grid Studies for Data Centers
entry.summary: The grid operator wants to combine studies of new power plants and large electricity users, but data center groups warn its annual entry window could add delays.

entry.title: Morpho Brings Stock-Token Loans to OKX’s X Layer
entry.summary: OKX Wallet advertises up to 350,000 USDC in launch incentives, including an xStocks-sponsored bonus for depositing eligible stock-token collateral.

entry.title: Blockaid Flags $3.9 Million in K3 and Reental Exploits
entry.summary: K3 Capital said it paused contracts as Blockaid reported losses from its sBOLD vault on Ethereum and a separate stablecoin drain on Polygon.

entry.title: Curve's CRV Falls 48% in Four Weeks, Lagging BTC and ETH
entry.summary: The token's slide outpaced bitcoin and ether as Curve reported lower trading fees and veCRV payouts in its Nov. 13 weekly update.

entry.title: Polymarket US Says It Is Adding Oil and Gas Markets
entry.summary: The company reports more than 300,000 short-duration crypto traders in six weeks. Energy filings describe price-threshold bets, with listing planned no earlier than Nov. 19.

entry.title: NEAR Says Take-Two–Linked Token Is Live on Near.com
entry.summary: The TTWO product is an Assetize debt certificate, not ownership of Take-Two shares. NEAR advertises round-the-clock, confidential trading.

entry.title: Anthropic Said to Price Enlarged IPO at $83 a Share
entry.summary: CNBC reported pricing above the $70–$78 range, while Bloomberg said the offering had increased in size. Anthropic had not posted final terms on its IPO website.

entry.title: CZ Says Anthropic Stock Tokens Will Reach BNB Chain on IPO Day
entry.summary: CZ named bStocks, Ondo and xStocks as routes to IPO-day exposure. Their products track shares but do not give holders direct equity ownership.

entry.title: Coinbase Launches US Spot Margin With Up to 10x Leverage
entry.summary: Access is limited to eligible contract participants—a standard that generally requires individuals to have more than $10 million invested on a discretionary basis.

entry.title: Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Neon for Complex AI Work
entry.summary: Standard paid API rates are $3 per million uncached input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. Access is also rolling out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

entry.title: Ledger Confirms Berlin Wallet Tampering, Probes Dubai
entry.summary: Ledger's UAE reseller directory lists Virgin Megastores' Ledger sales as temporarily paused, while investigator ZachXBT presses the company over compensation.

entry.title: Bitcoin's Rebound Fades With Price 50% Below Record
entry.summary: The Nov. 18 quote was 4.3% below the recovery The Defiant documented Sunday, but still above Saturday's four-month low.

entry.title: BTCPay Server Urges Emergency Update for Nginx Flaws
entry.summary: The fix updates the web-server dependency, not BTCPay's own version number. Docker operators should verify that their nginx container runs 1.31.9.

entry.title: Fed Minutes Point to More Hikes, Flag AI Inflation Risk
entry.summary: Bitcoin and ether slipped on Coinbase in the 10 minutes after the release. The October record showed broad support for further tightening, conditional on the economic outlook.

entry.title: Binance Says ADGM Order Supports Recovery of Hack Funds
entry.summary: Binance says it is pursuing frozen assets after committing more than $6.34 billion in company funds to cover losses from the hack.

entry.title: Astra vs. Fable: What Document and Knowledge Tests Show
entry.summary: In Artificial Analysis’ Max-setting tests, Astra leads GDP.pdf and Fable leads a factual-question net score that penalizes wrong answers. Neither establishes a winner for live research or reliable citations.

entry.title: Bitcoin Nears $62,000 as Citi Cuts Its Forecast
entry.summary: Bitcoin’s low was about 0.4% above its weekend trough on Coinbase. Citi strategist Alex Saunders lowered the bank’s base-case target to $99,532, CNBC reported.

entry.title: EIGEN Falls 48% in Four Weeks, Lagging Bitcoin, Ether
entry.summary: EigenCloud's restaking collateral was valued at $4.52 billion, down about 28.5% from an Oct. 21 snapshot.

entry.title: Variational Raises $110 Million to Expand Omni Trading
entry.summary: Bain Capital Crypto led the round at a $1.5 billion valuation. Variational plans higher trading limits and more traditional-asset markets.

entry.title: US Capital-Goods Import Prices Post Record Monthly Rise
entry.summary: Bitcoin slipped 0.2% across the release hour. Futures still pointed to higher rates into March, even though the implied average rate for March edged down at Tuesday's settlement.

entry.title: Backpack Secures NFA Approval Ahead of US Perps Launch
entry.summary: The futures intermediary approval follows CFTC exchange and clearinghouse orders. American customers still face a waitlist, not an open trading venue.

entry.title: How to Choose AI Coding Benchmarks That Fit Your Work
entry.summary: Repository answers, code edits and terminal jobs call for different tests. Here’s how to compare scores, spending and completion time.

entry.title: USDC’s Direct Bank Cash Fell $1.88 Billion in Q3
entry.summary: Directly held bank cash fell to $9.50 billion at September-end as total backing edged higher. The snapshots show a changed reserve mix but don’t establish whether redemption capacity changed.

entry.title: How Tokenized Nvidia Traded Through Two Weeks of Huang Headlines
entry.summary: Seven tokens give their holders a claim on the same Nvidia share. On Sunday 8 November, with every US exchange shut, that share was priced 6.3% apart depending on which token a holder owned.

entry.title: APT Drops 24% in a Week, Erasing Its Autumn Rally
entry.summary: The token is down roughly 47% over 28 days, a steeper loss than bitcoin, ether, SOL or SUI on comparable windows.

entry.title: Bullish Beats Adjusted Revenue Forecast as Spot Volume Falls
entry.summary: Subscription and services led Bullish’s year-over-year adjusted revenue growth, while digital-asset valuation gains drove a $576.3 million net profit.

entry.title: Bitcoin Sheds Most of Post-Nvidia Bounce in 35 Minutes
entry.summary: Bitcoin remained near $64,100 Wednesday morning, about 24% below its Oct. 21 intraday high, after a brief rally following Nvidia's earnings release.

entry.title: Binance Hack Wallet Moves Another $142 Million in ETH
entry.summary: Seven transfers redistributed the ether as records confirmed bitcoin swaps by a separate wallet linked to the previous day’s transfers.

entry.title: Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for Crypto Theft
entry.summary: Prosecutors counted 32 crypto theft victims and said seized funds could compensate most or all of them. A restitution hearing is set for Dec. 11.

entry.title: Ledger User Reports $320,000 Loss, Citing Berlin Purchase
entry.summary: Ledger Support asked the claimant to open a ticket. No implant has been confirmed, and the alleged Berlin purchase remains unverified.

entry.title: Binance Wallet's Anthropic xStocks Pool Hits 500M USDC Cap
entry.summary: Binance Wallet announced the closure nearly four hours before the scheduled deadline. Subscribers await pro-rata token allocations and refunds of unused USDC.

entry.title: Bitcoin Erases Summer Rally as ETF Outflows Persist
entry.summary: Bitcoin traded below its pre-rally August close on Coinbase, down 26% from its September peak, as US spot funds recorded further withdrawals.

entry.title: PancakeSwap Becomes Pancake; CAKE Needs No Migration
entry.summary: The exchange says its shorter name reflects an existing business in perpetual futures and tokenized stocks, rather than a new token or product launch.

entry.title: Etherscan Warns Users After Support Access Attempts
entry.summary: Users should not share private keys, recovery phrases or passwords, even with contacts that appear to be official support, the explorer said.

entry.title: The Graph’s Curation Burn Stays at 1% After 300,000 GRT Deposit
entry.summary: Lodestar estimates the deposit lifted one deployment’s modeled share of indexing rewards to 6.2%, after arbitrators declined to penalize self-curation alone.

entry.title: PyPI Quarantines Two Microsoft AI Framework Releases
entry.summary: Wiz and OX Security found credential-stealing code in agent-framework 1.26.1 and 1.26.2. They urge affected developers to remove the releases and rotate exposed secrets.

entry.title: LUKSO Urges Key Removal After Universal Profile Attack
entry.summary: LUKSO says holders must remove an attacker key and a malicious recovery controller; revoking permissions alone is not enough.

entry.title: Maple’s SYRUP Loses Half Its Value, Lagging BTC and ETH
entry.summary: SYRUP is about 27% below The Defiant’s Nov. 10 reading. Maple’s dashboard now lists an October buyback smaller than September’s.

entry.title: Paytaca Warns Users After Two Backend Security Attacks
entry.summary: The Bitcoin Cash wallet says attackers created fake orders and payment requests, while private keys remained on users’ devices.

entry.title: Polymarket Moves Hourly, Daily Crypto Bets to Chainlink
entry.summary: New contracts use 60-second average prices, while the November 18 daily markets retain their Binance-based rules.

entry.title: Ledger Users Report Losses From Dubai-Bought Wallets
entry.summary: Two users named Virgin Megastore as their purchase channel. A research registry identified an implant in one device from photos; the second case remains suspected.

entry.title: Nvidia Board Has No Plans to Reinstate Jensen Huang
entry.summary: Colette Kress remains interim CEO as directors search for a permanent successor, considering internal and external candidates.

entry.title: DBS, Circle Add 24/7 Institutional USDC Access in Asia
entry.summary: Eligible institutions can mint and redeem USDC through DBS, the companies say, adding a bank-based route for dollar-stablecoin liquidity.

entry.title: Ether.fi Token Falls 25%, Doubling Bitcoin's Weekly Loss
entry.summary: ETHFI is down about 32% over four weeks, while the protocol's staking TVL has fallen about 11% in the past week.

entry.title: PayPal’s PYUSD Supply Falls 14% as Ethereum Leads Drop
entry.summary: Ethereum accounted for about 85% of PYUSD’s net weekly contraction, while the dollar token’s price stayed near its peg.

entry.title: Nvidia Tops Sales Forecast After Huang's Resignation
entry.summary: Data-center revenue reached $107.6 billion. Nvidia's fourth-quarter outlook excludes China data-center compute sales, while shares rose about 4% after hours.

entry.title: USD1 Supply Falls 11% in a Week to Below $3 Billion
entry.summary: World Liberty Financial's stablecoin reached its lowest daily supply reading in a 30-day window, with declines across Solana, Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain.

entry.title: Java4Shell Fixes Arrive After AI-Assisted Discovery
entry.summary: The flaw exposes unpatched Java applications on certain x86-64 processors. Calif and Wiz describe AI-assisted exploit development measured in hours.

entry.title: Bank of England Finalizes Clearing-House Test Policy
entry.summary: Blockchain-based entrants are included in a technology-neutral route for limited live testing. The new rule-waiver policy is expected to take effect in 2027.

entry.title: The Graph to Tie Indexer Reward Requirements to Stake
entry.summary: Step 4 raises the service bar for operators above 40 million GRT, with existing 14-day eligibility periods cushioning the transition.

entry.title: FDIC Proposes Rules for Custodial-Deposit Exemption
entry.summary: The proposal details which client funds smaller banks could exclude from brokered deposits, with potential savings on deposit-insurance assessments.

entry.title: FT Reports $104 Billion in Nvidia Singapore Revenue
entry.summary: Nvidia switched its geographic sales breakdown from customer billing addresses to headquarters in 2025. Neither measure identifies where chips ultimately operate.

entry.title: Binance Wallet Sets Eight-Hour Anthropic IPO Token Window
entry.summary: The campaign is capped at 500 million USDC and carries a 5% xStocks fee. Allocations are not guaranteed and deliver tokens, not shares.

entry.title: World Bank Group Explores USDC Payments With Citi
entry.summary: Circle's USDC infrastructure and Citi's banking connections will underpin an exploration of stablecoin-based development-fund payments, not a live rollout.

entry.title: Blockaid Says B18TimeBank Exploit Drained 404,540 USDC
entry.summary: Onchain records confirm the payout on Base. About 106,785 USDC remained in the settlement contract during a subsequent check; containment was unconfirmed.

entry.title: Microsoft Makes Cobalt 200 VMs Available in 14 Regions
entry.summary: The Arm-based instances add high-memory and storage options as Microsoft prepares to expand deployment of its own server silicon.

entry.title: Brevan Howard Triples IBIT Stake to $1.1 Billion
entry.summary: The investment manager reported 22.4 million IBIT shares at September’s end, up about 211% from June. Separate options positions are excluded from that total.

entry.title: Anthropic Pairs IPO With $26 Billion Tech-Backer Deal
entry.summary: Google, Nvidia and five other tech companies agreed to buy stock at the IPO price. Google's purchase partly funds an earlier commitment.

entry.title: FinCEN Proposes Tighter ID Rules for Business Accounts
entry.summary: The plan would bar ITINs for beneficial-owner identification and expressly allow risk-based immigration checks, without adding money services businesses to its coverage.

entry.title: Western Union Says Solana Cash-Out Network Is Live
entry.summary: Solana cites access to 400,000 cash-pickup locations, but Western Union’s consumer site still lists global cash-out as ‘coming soon.’
